title: REQ · Server serves only round admin routes and the backend compiles without execution code
summary: server.New no longer wires execution routes; admin routes are the round routes only.
description: Context: backend/internal/server/server.go imports internal/execution, builds exStore and eh, and adminRoutes returns /executions, /executions/{id}/retry and /executions/{id}/approve before the round routes. Desired behavior: those imports, variables and routes are removed and New mounts adminRoundRoutes(rh) behind admin.Middleware. Expected result: remaining packages compile and tests pass. Why: nothing may import removed code.
acceptance_criteria: Given server.New, when the router is walked, then /api/v1/admin serves exactly the five round routes and no /executions route.
Given any Go file under backend/, when imports are read, then none import internal/execution.
Given go build ./... and go test for server, then both succeed.

preserve: Round admin routes and token middleware

definition_of_done: Server builds and its tests pass
